topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: To ensure consistent Line of Sight (LOS) connectivity for Air-to-Air (A2A) links in dynamically changing flight formations, adaptive beamforming techniques can be employed to track changing LOS paths. Coordinated Multi-Point (CoMP) techniques can also be used for simultaneous transmission to multiple aircraft, reducing co-channel interference and increasing Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR). Exploiting GPS for synchronization among network nodes allows for scheduling contention-free transmissions, reducing packet loss and improving overall system capacity. These approaches mitigate the effects of frequency selective fading and Rician distributed fading, ensuring consistent LOS connectivity.
reference_context: Aeronautical communication systems face challenges due to rapidly fluctuating frequency selective fading, high velocity, and Rician distributed fading in dynamically changing flight formations. Aircraft are equipped with GPS for navigation purposes, providing a global time reference that can be exploited for synchronization among network nodes.
